name: UI/UX Designer

sections.daily_work: Research user needs, sketch wireframes, create prototypes in Figma. Test designs with real users. Collaborate with developers to implement designs.
sections.learning: Design principles (color, typography, layout), Figma or Adobe XD, user research methods, prototyping, accessibility, basic HTML/CSS helps.
sections.pay: Entry-level typically starts around $45,000-$70,000 USD. Mid-level $70,000-$110,000. Senior designers can earn $120,000+. Verify for your region.
sections.entry_routes: Self-learning via Google UX Design Certificate (Coursera), design bootcamps, portfolio of design projects, fine arts or interaction design degree, networking in design communities.

try_in_real_life: Complete the free Google UX Design course on Coursera
Redesign an app or website you use daily (before/after)
Create a free Figma account and prototype a simple app
Conduct a mini user interview: ask 3 friends about an app they love
sources: UX Design salary surveys (NN/g, UX Design Institute); creative industry reports
